# The financial health platform for _great financial decisions_

nudge® is a personalized employee financial health platform combining intelligent technology, impartial financial guidance, and CFP®-qualified human coaching to support every employee, across every location, and stage of working life.

[Get a demo](https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform#)

how it works

## A financial health platform powered by technology and human expertise

Most financial wellbeing platforms are built for scale, not for the moment it gets personal. nudge was built for both. Every employee gets a personalized financial action plan. Our intelligent technology personalizes impartial financial guidance for every employee, continuously, with CFP®-qualified coaches ready to step in at the moments that matter most. Together, they create something neither could deliver alone.

Intelligent technology

### AI-enabled guidance changes financial behavior

Behind every personalized experience sits numa, nudge's AI. Working continuously in the background to identify the right guidance for each employee, deliver it when it actually matters, and update their action plan accordingly.

### Real-time behavioral science

People don't always act on what they know. Behavioral science bridges that gap by identifying where employees get stuck and designing the right moment, message, and prompt to move them forward with their action plan.

### Proactive engagement

nudge reaches employees when financial decisions arise. From major life events and open enrollment to periods of market uncertainty, and through the channels they already use, including your benefits platform, SMS, email, WhatsApp, and Microsoft Teams.

### Enterprise scalability

Deep integration with HRIS and benefits platforms connects your data into one experience. Improving personalization, increasing benefit utilization, and giving HR teams workforce insights they've never had before.

human expertise

### CFP®-qualified coaching

nudge coaches are CFP®-qualified employees. They're trained on your specific benefits package and operate under a strict "educate, empower, never prescribe" framework. No commissions or conflicts of interest. Coaching sessions are booked through, and hosted on nudge for a connected employee experience.

### Live webinars

Live, facilitated group sessions that bring employees together around the financial topics that matter most to them. Real discussion, shared questions, collective progress. With on-demand versions available for those who can't join live.

### One-on-one support at key financial decisions

When employees hit a major financial decision, they can access private coaching. Each session feeds directly into the employee's personalized action plan on nudge, so the conversation becomes clear next steps that numa helps employees prioritize after the call.

### Global reach, local expertise

The same standard of financial health support, wherever your employees are in the world. Country-specific guidance, regional coaching expertise, local benefit knowledge, and content available in the languages your people speak.

### A personalized financial action plan for every employee

nudge features

## Inside the platform

[Get a demo](https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform#)

nudge brings together the tools, impartial guidance, and coaching that turn financial awareness into financial action.

### Prompts

1/6

nudge reaches employees before they go looking for support. Timely, personalized messages arrive at the moments financial decisions arise, through the channels they already use. And when employees do have a question, numa, nudge's AI, is there to answer it any time of day.

### Understanding

2/6

Before nudge can guide someone, it builds a picture of where they actually stand. The financial health checkup maps their situation across five pillars, the budgeting planner turns income and expenses into a clear financial snapshot, and numa connects their questions to benefits they may not know they have.

### Build my plan

3/6

Every employee gets their own financial action plan, built specifically around their situation, goals, and available benefits. It isn't static so as they complete actions and circumstances change, the plan evolves with them.

### Guide

4/6

With that picture in place, every employee gets impartial financial guidance that fits their life. Personalized content, money-modelling tools, a live feed of relevant financial education, and on-demand webinars on the topics they're actually dealing with.

### Talk to an expert

5/6

When the stakes are highest, employees can access one-on-one support from a CFP-qualified coach, or join a live webinar built for real discussion. Human expertise, fully integrated into the platform, not bolted on.

### Track the change

6/6

Employees watch their financial health score improve over time. HR and reward teams get real-time workforce insight through nudgenomics, tracking engagement, benefit utilization, and program impact across the whole organization so you can see your ROI.
